# College Study Hub — Copilot Instructions

These rules apply to every task in this project:

1. Keep all course materials and personal data on the user's computer.
2. Do not add a backend, accounts, cloud sync, analytics, telemetry, or external AI APIs.
3. Use modular, maintainable TypeScript with strict type checking.
4. Keep database operations in dedicated repositories and services.
5. Never delete user data to fix an error.
6. Add database migrations whenever the schema changes.
7. Never execute imported HTML or JavaScript files.
8. Add tests for features and run the production build.
9. Do not rewrite unrelated working code.
10. Before each task, inspect the code and explain the plan.
11. After each task, report changed files, tests run, build results, and known limitations.
12. Build one milestone at a time.
